plainTranslation:
This connection makes original thinking feel natural.

You may find it easy to say things around this person that you would normally keep to yourself. Strange ideas do not feel so strange here. Thoughts move quickly, but usually in a way that feels exciting rather than stressful. You can run with an idea without having to apologize for where it takes you.

At its best, this aspect gives both people real mental freedom. The world may ask you to tone yourself down or explain yourself carefully. With this person, you may not have to. They understand the jump. They follow the thread. They help you trust the part of your mind that does not think in a straight line.

This can create a closeness that feels important. Not because it is dramatic, but because it is rare to feel met at the level of thought. You may become better thinkers together. More inventive. More honest. More willing to question what you used to accept.

The challenge is that the ease can make you careless.

Because understanding comes naturally, you may not practice patience when it is needed. You may skip over misunderstandings instead of working through them. You may also start to see ordinary life as dull, as though errands, bills, routines, and practical details are beneath the brilliance of the connection.

But real life still needs tending.

There is also an emotional trap here. You may process difficult feelings by reframing them, explaining them, or finding the clever angle. Some feelings do not need a new angle. They need time. Grief needs to be felt. Anger needs to be said. Disappointment needs room.

Ground the brilliance in something real. Make the thing. Finish the idea. Stay present for the ordinary parts of life. Put as much care into your bodies, feelings, and routines as you put into your minds.

Ideas come easily here. Finishing something is the part that matters.
